messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — we have the marketplace launch target 2026-05-15. Need final SOC2 snapshot, pen test window, and SI/HSM artifact handoff timeline. Who owns the upload and what’s the cadence?
Marco: tagging @Claire for compliance details. also need to confirm partner PR embargo window.
Claire: I can own the SOC2 snapshot upload + attestation doc. Pen test report will be staged by security ops; need SI to sign NDA for full report access.
Vic: from infra side, we can generate presigned links and set TTL. Recommend 7 days for full reports, 24h for screenshots.
Aisha: ok — SI partner (SiliconWorks) needs an HSM attestation included. Marco, can you confirm they can produce that by May 5?
Marco: pinged their lead, they said tentative May 4-6 for HSM attestation. I'll get confirmation today.
Claire: action items: 1) SOC snapshot export (me) 2) Pen test final PDF (security ops) 3) HSM attestation (SiliconWorks) 4) Presign process (Vic) 5) Redaction step (partner + us).
Vic: presign example (we'll run under redwood-ci role):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence/soc2-2026-05.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```
Make sure object ACL is private.
Aisha: redaction — SiliconWorks will mark any customer PII, but we should run a quick pass. Marco can you allocate a devex reviewer?
Marco: assigned Claire and me for a quick redaction QA. We'll do a single-pass within 24h of uploads.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace listing checklist item #9 (security artifacts) is due 2026-05-07.
Claire: NDA requirement: SI needs to sign our standard marketplace access NDA before we hand over the pen test. I have the doc ready, sending now.
Aisha: good. Also need to plan a short joint announcement note for partners — can ops confirm any embargo dates that would affect PR?
Vic: no infra blockers for embargo. If the HSM attestation slips past May 6 it may delay partner co-announcement.
Marco: SiliconWorks confirmed HSM attestation for May 4. They requested a 48h blackout before public announcement for legal review.
Aisha: noted. So timeline: SOC snapshot upload by May 2, pen test final by May 3, HSM attestation May 4, redaction + presign + QA May 5, internal sign-off May 6, announcement May 8 (soft) / May 15 public launch.
Claire: I'll create a minimal checklist and attach to the PR review.
Aisha: perfect. If anything slips, we'll fall back to a limited listing (no HSM attestation) but keep the marketplace tile live. That fallback must be approved by eng & legal.
Vic: can we get a short runbook for the presign + TTL process? I can draft and push to docs.
Marco: will coordinate partner comms and embargo note. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
MarketplaceBot: File created: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/checklists/2864217345 (for ops use)
